description: Hreflang checker — International SEO audit of a page's hreflang annotations (HTML head + HTTP Link header): validates language/region codes (ISO 639-1 / ISO 3166-1, catches en-UK, en_US, country-as-language, deprecated iw/in), duplicate/conflicting codes, relative URLs, missing x-default, missing self-reference, canonical conflicts, then fetches up to limit= alternates (default 10, max 20) to verify each returns 200 and links back (reciprocal return links). Returns entries, return-link table, issues, PASS/WARN/FAIL/NO HREFLANG and a 0-100 score. Optional: limit=. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: web_hreflang_check
